# schedule/

Weekly traffic patterns for evaluating the schedule proposals (decision-model feature 7), rendered by
`scripts/decider_eval/schedule_eval.py` into one-minute rollups, traffic profiles and candidate windows with DGXMM's
own code.

- `patterns.jsonl`: one pattern per line — `pattern` (office, office_late, nightly_batch, weekend, lunch,
  short_gap, office_stray, irregular, always_on), `days` of data, deployment `priority`, the host's memory
  `pressure` summary and a `seed` for the random parts (stray night use, irregular hours).
- Busy minutes are real one-minute rollups of a throwaway test deployment's traffic
  (`../../workload/raw/prod-h1-wl.rollups.json`, generated by this project; no user traffic); the arrangement into
  weeks is synthetic. Labels follow the policy in the script's docstring.

Provenance: generated by this project. No model weights, user data, deployment names or host identifiers.
